notes: purchase returns without invoice: generated screen took ST_ITEM_UNIT as master (wrong); corrected to ST_TRNS_MAST + ST_TRNS_DET like ST_RETURN_COST; legacy rules in APP_RULES_PR Wave 3b: lots of the item with a positive balance in the store before the line (legacy CONFG LOV with GET_BALANCE_CONFG), legacy return-type / store / supplier / item / unit lists, posting check boxes, item name and lot expiry.

validations.name: posted / cancelled / closed-period document is read-only

after_save.name: legacy KEY-COMMIT checks and derived values

rules.where: TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT T.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNS_TYPE T WHERE T.EFFECT = 3 AND T.TRNS_TYPE IN (3, 5)) AND NVL(DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0 AND (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 OR TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD WHERE FLAG = 1 AND PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) AND RET_TRNS_TYPE_CODE IS NULL

ST_TRNS_MAST.TRNS_TYPE_CODE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from st_trns_type where effect = 3 and trns_type in (3, 5) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_MAST.STORE_CODE.lov: select st.store_code || ' - ' || st.name_a d, st.store_code r from st_store st where nvl(st.store_status, 0) = 1 and nvl(st.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or st.store_code in (select s2.store_code from st_store s2, st_chart_structure chrt, st_store_password sp where s2.store_status = 1 and sp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and sp.flag = 1 and chrt.chr_stru_level = (select s3.store_level from st_store s3 where s3.store_code = sp.store_code) and chrt.chr_type = 1 and substr(sp.store_code, 1, chrt.chr_stru_end) = substr(s2.store_code, 1, chrt.chr_stru_end))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_MAST.SUPPLIER_CODE.lov: select s.code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.code r from supplier s where nvl(s.stopflag, 0) = 0 and nvl(s.supplier_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (s.code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and s.code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_DET.UNIT_CODE.lov: select u.unit_code || ' - ' || u.name_a || decode(iu.basic_unit, 1, ' (وحدة أساسية)', '') d, u.unit_code r from st_item_unit iu, st_unit u where iu.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE and (iu.group_code = :PAGE_GROUP_CODE or :PAGE_GROUP_CODE is null) and iu.unit_code = u.unit_code order by 2

ST_TRNS_DET.ITEM_CODE.lov: select it.item_code || ' - ' || nvl(it.name_a, it.name_e) d, it.item_code r from st_item it, st_item_unit iu where nvl(it.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and it.item_group_code = iu.group_code and it.item_code = iu.item_code and nvl(iu.basic_unit, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or it.item_group_code in (select gp.group_code from st_group_password gp where gp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_TRNS_DET.ITEM_CONFG_ID.lov: select g.item_confg_id || ' - ' || to_char(g.expire_date, 'DD-MM-YYYY') || nvl2(g.lot_number, ' - ' || g.lot_number, '') || ' - الرصيد ' || get_balance_confg(m.store_code, g.group_code, g.item_code, g.item_confg_id, m.trns_date, m.date_serial, :PAGE_ITEM_SERIAL) d, g.item_confg_id r from st_item_confg g, st_trns_mast m where g.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE and (g.group_code = :PAGE_GROUP_CODE or :PAGE_GROUP_CODE is null) and m.trns_type_code = :PAGE_TRNS_TYPE_CODE and m.trns_serial = :PAGE_TRNS_SERIAL and get_balance_confg(m.store_code, g.group_code, g.item_code, g.item_confg_id, m.trns_date, m.date_serial, :PAGE_ITEM_SERIAL) > 0 order by g.item_confg_id

ST_TRNS_DET.ITEM_NAME_A.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_a, i.name_e)) from st_item i where i.item_code = t.item_code and i.item_group_code = t.group_code)

ST_TRNS_DET.LOT_EXPIRE.sql: (select max(g.expire_date) from st_item_confg g where g.item_confg_id = t.item_confg_id)
